def factor_breakout_hold_confirmation_20d_refined(df):
    """Idea: A close above the prior 20-day high, followed by two sessions holding that resistance, confirms supply absorption; the signal is stronger when the breakout day closed in the upper part of its range and volume was above its 20-day median.

    Logic: The breakout resistance is built directly as the trailing 20-day high of high shifted three bars, so a single series represents the fixed resistance for the breakout bar and the two hold bars. The confirmed-breakout mask multiplies the percentage hold distance by the breakout-day close location and the breakout-day above-median volume flag. This preserves the parent mechanism while removing redundant shift operations on the prior-high series.

    Sub-mechanism tags: breakout, hold-confirmation, close-location, volume-confirmation.

    Formula: I(close_{t-2} > R) * I(close_{t-1} >= R) * I(close_t >= R) * (close_t / R - 1) * close_loc_{t-2} * I(vol_{t-2} > median20_{t-2}), R = max(high_{t-22..t-3})
    """
    df_copy = df.copy()
    resistance = df_copy["high"].shift(3).rolling(20, min_periods=20).max()
    breakout = (df_copy["close"].shift(2) > resistance).astype(float)
    hold1 = (df_copy["close"].shift(1) >= resistance).astype(float)
    hold2 = (df_copy["close"] >= resistance).astype(float)
    confirmed = breakout * hold1 * hold2
    close_loc = ((df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]) / (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.5)
    volume_confirm = (df_copy["volume"].shift(2) > df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(2)).astype(float)
    hold_dist = ((df_copy["close"] - resistance) / resistance.replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
    factor = confirmed * hold_dist * close_loc.shift(2) * volume_confirm
    return factor.rename("factor_breakout_hold_confirmation_20d_refined")
